snippet.title: Nanuka: Secret of the Shattering Moon Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
An exciting action-platformer inspired by the style of 90s animation. Fight your way through a handcrafted, pixel art world, recruit allies to power up your gameplay and enjoy cool combat moves in a thrilling adventure packed with action and charm.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810190/Nanuka_Secret_of_the_Shattering_Moon/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
